items.title: Shelly Berg interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 15, 2000

ctx.x: Played piano and orchestrated for Kiss on their recent “Psycho Circus” album. And Gene Simmons actually is an interesting guy and when we were working with him I had a writing partner and we asked him how are the rehearsals going for the tour? He said, “What does it matter?” He said, “We can suck and fifty thousand people will come to every concert.” He said, “The problem with you jazz musicians is you want to play good for seventy-five dollars.”
